dependencies.name: qttools
dependencies.$comment: Source of macdeployqt; qtbase only builds the deploy tool on Windows.

dependencies.name: libslirp
dependencies.$comment: SLIP/PPP guest networking. Browsers have no raw sockets, so wasm builds omit it.

dependencies.name: libpcap
dependencies.$comment: Bridged host networking. On Windows the same feature builds against the Npcap SDK instead; the vcpkg libpcap port there is a capture-less stub.

dependencies.name: npcap-sdk
dependencies.$comment: Overlay port in cmake/vcpkg-ports. Headers and import libraries only; the Npcap runtime is installed by the user and must never be redistributed.

dependencies.name: pkgconf
dependencies.$comment: libslirp ships only pkg-config metadata and the vcpkg toolchain does not provide pkg-config.
